runtime.supportProbabilityInterpolation: linear between adjacent anchors; clamp settings to 50..150
runtime.cumulativeRoleFormula: T(0)=0; T(n)=n*(n+1)/2 + floor((n-1)^2/4) for n>=1; total multiplier = role base * T(n)
runtime.medalRounding: floor(BET * cumulative multiplier) separately for line, triangle and hexagon; sum these three integer totals plus all-clear bonus; award events pay the difference from the previous rounded total
runtime.carry: carry through completed positive own-WIN games; completed own zero-WIN resets; all-clear awards do not consume the progressive; no resets at block boundaries

method.draws: 8 unique numbers sampled uniformly without replacement from 1..25, grouped 3/2/1/1/1
method.rng: Separate seeded pseudorandom streams for per-game board seeds and number shuffles; the same pair is reused across settings for comparisons, but each run has its own continuous carry
method.calibration: A/B were used to choose the support probability anchors. Their rerun is calibration confirmation, not holdout evidence. C/D were first used after the anchors and payouts were frozen. No rule change followed the C/D results.
method.uncertainty: Approximate Student-t intervals using standard error of consecutive 200-game block means; df=19 per run and df=39 for each combined setting. Carry is continuous across blocks; block estimates reduce, but do not prove the absence of, serial dependence. These are simulation intervals, not theoretical RTP or short-session guarantees.
method.scope: Direct Six Drop role and all-clear payouts at fixed BET 100 and fixed rate; excludes shared Sugar/JPC awards, adaptive server payout feedback, other BET sizes, and the physical roulette distribution.
